verdict: Arm's revenue rose 12% to a record first-quarter $1,053M as royalties jumped 25% to $585M — but record R&D spending cut GAAP net income to $130M, down from $223M a year ago.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago; a record first quarter

segments.name: License and other revenue
segments.note: Fees for licensing Arm chip designs, plus support and related services; down 1% YoY on the normal timing and size of high-value license agreements and contributions from backlog.

segments.name: Royalty revenue
segments.note: A cut of every chip shipped with Arm technology inside; up 25% YoY on adoption of the newer Armv9 designs, the ramp of chips based on Arm CSS (ready-made compute subsystems), and more Arm-based chips in data centers.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Designing new processors and platform technology; the GAAP figure includes $174M of share-based pay (paying staff in shares) and $36M of related employer taxes.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling and running the company; the GAAP figure includes $60M of share-based pay and $17M of related employer taxes.

follow100Note: Royalties alone are $55.56 of every $100 Arm takes in — and R&D, at $61.73 of every $100, is by far the biggest use of it.
otherDetail: Combined other income was $32M: $27M of net interest income plus $1M of other non-operating income, plus a $4M gain from equity investments (the separate equity line). Tax was a $16M charge, an 11.0% effective rate on $146M of pre-tax income.
footerNote: Arm calls its direct cost 'cost of sales' ($30M).

takeaways.title: Royalties set a first-quarter record
takeaways.text: Royalty revenue rose 25% to $585M, a record for a first quarter, while license revenue eased 1% to $468M — total revenue of $1,053M was Arm's second billion-dollar quarter in a row.

takeaways.title: Record R&D spending squeezed operating profit
takeaways.text: GAAP research and development jumped to $650M from $485M a year ago as engineering headcount grew, so operating income fell to $114M from $182M despite the record revenue.

takeaways.title: GAAP profit fell; the adjusted picture was steadier
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was $0.12, down from $0.21 a year ago, while non-GAAP EPS was $0.35. Arm generated $332M of operating cash flow and $150M of non-GAAP free cash flow.
